description: This file defines the MimeType class in the GuzzleHttp PSR7 namespace, providing static methods to determine MIME types based on file extensions or filenames.

classes.name: MimeType
classes.description: A utility class for determining MIME types from filenames or extensions.

methods.name: fromFilename
methods.description: Determines the MIME type of a file based on its filename extension.

methods.name: fromExtension
methods.description: Maps a file extension to its corresponding MIME type.
